name: @deterministic-code/typescript-generators
description: TypeScript generator pack for the deterministic toolchain: the emit-*-typescript lane modules + frontend/client/zod helpers.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R src/templates dist/ && cp src/sdk/default-settings.yaml dist/sdk/ && cp -R src/sdk/field-types dist/sdk/ && cp -R src/sdk/templates dist/sdk/
